_meta.source: definition.py hints, docs/f-reference/<m>.md (advect, glow, grain read; others hints only); nothing run
_meta.scope: float/int params only; menus and buttons (screen, plate_mode, sep_mode, mode, variant, mmode, polar_sw, bayer_cell, plate_out, wet) are out of scope per spec
_meta.conf: high/med/low = how sure J1 is; low rows are where J2 is expected to disagree
_meta.typed: 2026-11-22: H3 soft typing added (spec). 'typed' marks params whose default widget a type rule decides; their J1 role is kept as a record but they are not judged under H2
_meta.set_aside: 2026-11-22: f_halftone, f_separate, f_vf_erode, f_weave, f_lens, f_grain are set aside from the pilot (substantive layout customization already; Matt's rule). Their roles here are kept as an answer key to compare with his layouts later, not as spike evidence
_meta.new_pilot: 2026-11-22: J1 added for f_stipple, f_quasi, f_vf_seeds, f_vf_vortex, f_tf_hatch, f_vf_ch (docs read for all six; vortex, hatch, ch, stipple, seeds tables; quasi from hints only). H3 typing applied. Same offline judge as before, seen before any J2
_meta.pool: 2026-11-22: J1 added for the 15 remaining untouched pool modules (hints only, no docs read; f_vf_split has no controls). Same offline judge

pitch.why: Names the effect: the ruling of the screen, the first thing moved; changes the look from fine to coarse

jitter.why: Regular lattice to scattered: a change of kind, but Dot only and not obviously live

level.why: Threshold screen only: sets where ink starts. Primary only while screen=Threshold (mode-conditional)

dot_shape.why: Round to square at equal inked area: changes the mark, not the structure; Dot only

levels.why: Number of output steps for Bayer/Blue/Random; a quality setting

angle_r.why: Sets the moire rosette, so it is structural, but the 15/75/45 defaults are conventional and set once

phase_r_x.why: Shifts the lattice; registration, not character

ink1_h.why: Hue names the ink, so it decides what the plates are; S and L only refine it

n_inks.why: How many plates exist; a change of kind, but set up once

flow.why: How hard the terrain drives the water; the pooling-in-low-places behavior depends on it (inlet 1)

lift.why: With Settle decides whether pigment travels or stays: spreading versus pooling

settle.why: Paired with Lift; one of the two may be enough to call primary

push.why: Only matters with a vecfield on inlet 2; 0 equals no vecfield. Could be primary in a wind-driven patch

dry.why: Rate the water goes; a tuning value

speed.why: Solver step size, bounded for stability

feed.why: Switches wet-once to continuous for animated input: a change of mode, but only for animated sources

density.why: Cell scale: how many marks across; the first thing set

angle.why: Line orientation; defines the look and is moved live

marklen.why: Dashes versus continuous lines: changes the kind of mark

offset.why: Grid-like versus staggered; structural, but a mild one next to the other four

phase.why: Animation scroll; performed live, so an expected exception (secondary by role, live by use)

irreg.why: Depth of the chosen irregularity variant; the variant menu is the real driver

aberration.why: One of the three lens defects that define the module

distortion.why: Barrel or pincushion: the defining lens defect

transmission.why: Vignette; a lens defect, but plainly milder than the other two

ghost.why: A distinct additive layer. Arguably primary: this module is a bundle of independent effects, so kind versus degree is weak here

halation.why: As ghost: a separate additive layer, gated by its threshold

decay.why: Frame retention: below 1 fades, above 1 is the excitable regime; sets whether it is a smear, a trail or a feedback

dt.why: Flow speed, moved live. Closer to degree than kind, so borderline

injection.why: Source bleed-in; settles at Inject / (1 - Decay), so it depends on Decay

separate.why: A chroma stage with no hint or doc line read; inferred from the name

radius.why: Extent of the glow; the first thing set

direction.why: int 0-2, hint empty: inferred from the name that it picks along or against the field. Unverified

falloff.why: Shape of the Gaussian weights; no hint, inferred

color_mix.why: No hint; inferred as a color blend of the glow

density.why: How many cells carry a grain

luma_gate.why: Where the grain lands (shadows or highlights); structural but perhaps a refinement

fade.why: Width of the era fade envelope

displace.why: Per-grain displacement; a separate effect, so could be primary

coarseness.why: Grain size: the first thing set; fine dust to chunky grain

anisotropy.why: Isotropic grain, parallel lines or aliasing: a change of kind

threshold.why: How much white the dither gives; tonal amount, but the control you play with. Meaning differs by source and processor mode

freq.why: Affects only the parallel hash, so it depends on Anisotropy

zoom.why: Same character, bigger or smaller (stated in the hint)

colorize.why: Processor mode only: mono versus input color

along_phase.why: Hash offset, driven externally for drift

across_phase.why: Hash offset, driven externally for drift

angle.why: Orientation of the frame; circular by type

density.why: Bands per frame height: the texture's fineness, the first thing set

envelope.why: One scale dominating versus a wider mix of octaves: changes the character of the pattern

zoom.why: Cyclic scale offset (a clock adds to it); density sets the base scale. Candidate for an H3 extension (cyclic wrap)

drift.why: Cyclic phase offset (a clock adds to it); same candidate

zoom_rate.why: Motion clock; performed live in an animated patch

bands.why: Contour count on the look outlet only

angle.why: Rotates the wave directions together; circular by type

density.why: How many seeds: the first thing set

jitter.why: Grid versus scatter: a change of kind

stretch.why: Round marks versus elongated along the field; kind of mark, but only with a field

strength.why: Vecfield influence on orientation; depends on a vecfield

mag_weight.why: Depth of field-magnitude to mark size

field_priority.why: Seed selection Voronoi versus field magnitude; changes how marks overlap, but advanced and degenerate at 1.0

field_gain.why: Scale of field priority; window varies by field source

phase.why: Scroll for motion; performed live (as f_weave's phase)

color_mode.why: Blend of the shape color and the driving texture's color

bomb.why: Second sample per cell; behaves as on/off

convergence.why: Sink versus source: names the field

curl.why: Rotation direction and strength: names the field

falloff.why: Reach of the field; shapes it but does not change its kind

cx.why: Center X; placement, but moved live in a performance and paired with cy

grain.why: Fine thin strokes versus coarse thick ones

line_hard.why: Soft strokes versus hard engraved lines: a style change, one dial

angle_offset.why: Rotates strokes against the structure axis (+-90 degrees); circular by type

coarsen.why: How fast the pattern merges into bigger blobs; the Cahn-Hilliard behavior, 0 = carried only

inject.why: How strongly the input deposits phase B: the driver from the source, cubic

dt.why: Advection step: pattern speed, moved live. Same call as f_vf_advect dt (degree more than kind, borderline)

iface.why: Crisp versus soft edge between the flows; a degree

thresh.why: Gate on Inject; depends on it

pull.why: Relaxes the mean toward Fill; balance

fill.why: Reset mean and the Pull target

scale.why: Propagation distance: sheets fold at larger values; the look

note.why: Selects the Bessel mode: names the pattern

linesharpness.why: Nodal line thickness; the look of the lines, tonal more than structural

reflectamt.why: Adds a reflected wave; a modest change

scale.why: Grain: bold coarse cells to fine

rate.why: Evolution speed (live lever, degree more than kind; same call as dt)

n_mirrors.why: Mirror count: the shape of the fold

depth_factor.why: The one control: depth to displacement

length.why: Blur length along the structure axis

width_gate.why: How the kernel width responds to coherence: the blur's shape

strength_scale.why: Calibration gate, to be set with tensormap's strength

strength.why: Must equal tensormap's own strength dial: a correctness value

grid.why: Cells across; the real control per its hint

angle.why: Base flow direction, 0 to 1 is a full circle

spread.why: How much the texture perturbs the direction: uniform versus textured flow

viscosity.why: Water versus honey: only big swirls survive

project.why: Compressible shocks versus divergence-free swirl: a change of kind

force.why: How hard the input pushes the flow

dt.why: Solver time step; numerical more than a lever

decay.why: Persistence of the accumulated flow; above 1 is excitable

injection.why: Fresh solve blend; depends on Decay

decay.why: Memory length of the accumulated potential

dt.why: Accumulation speed; same call as other dt

reach.why: How far the prism effect reaches

spread.why: Chromatic separation between R, G and B: the prism

threshold.why: Which pixels cast color; a gate

reach.why: Ring sample radius; negative samples inside shapes

threshold.why: Which luma repels; negative repels from dark

gain.why: Field magnitude, negative attracts. Primary in effect, but gain is a companion by H3

length.why: Streak length; hint empty, inferred from the name

pulse_depth.why: Excitability: 0 fades the field, 1.5 kills it

grain_scale.why: Pattern scale: finer and wormier versus bigger spots

sim_rate.why: Slow motion; the same look slower

pulse_period.why: Internal pulse period, used when no pulse is plugged in

pulse_mix.why: Pulse texture versus internal wave: a companion blend

pulse_gain.why: Pulse texture trim before it becomes the pulse: a companion
